d: US President Donald Trump has demanded an immediate investigation into what he calls a “massive and purposeful” error in earlier US GDP estimates. The Commerce Department revised third-quarter economic growth sharply higher to 4.3%, up from the initial estimate of 3.4%. Trump accused his administration of deliberately under-reporting economic growth but offered no evidence of manipulation. The controversy comes after his previous dismissal of the US Labour Statistics chief over disappointing jobs data.
